dispositions.local_proposition: Presentation credential valid at submission; review can occur later.
dispositions.relying_proposition: Previously verified credential is currently valid at a later admission boundary.
dispositions.precondition_analysis: Requires initially valid credential, competent effective revocation, later decision explicitly requiring current credential validity. Whether policy requires fresh credential check at later review is not universal.
dispositions.trigger: The relying system evaluates current validity using artifact evidence that does not incorporate the effective revocation state.
falsification: The system returns PASS for current validity after an authoritative revocation is known to be effective.
The system cannot establish current revocation state but converts that uncertainty into PASS.
dispositions.authority: VTC owns admission decision; applicable governance framework may constrain policy; live authority cannot be conferred by policy alone.
dispositions.expected_safe_outcome: Verify status at applicable current-validity boundary; deny or defer if revoked or unestablished; do not invalidate an earlier lawful decision retroactively.
dispositions.comparison: added-value conditional on later current-validity requirement; local submit already verifies revocation.

dispositions.local_proposition: Membership credential was valid and community reports effective removal.
dispositions.relying_proposition: Credential remains currently valid after competent effective status revocation.
dispositions.precondition_analysis: Requires initially valid VMC, competent revocation effective before later current-validity query. Departure alone is not proof of every artifact revocation; verify actual status and timing.
dispositions.trigger: The relying system evaluates current validity using artifact evidence that does not incorporate the effective revocation state.
falsification: The system returns PASS for current validity after an authoritative revocation is known to be effective.
The system cannot establish current revocation state but converts that uncertainty into PASS.
dispositions.authority: VTC owns lifecycle decision; member initiates own departure; administrator requires applicable community authority and policy controls.
dispositions.expected_safe_outcome: Reject revoked VMC for current validity or return indeterminate if status unavailable; preserve historical question separately.
dispositions.potential_impact: Former member and service; improper membership reliance.
dispositions.comparison: added-value: connects issued artifact to separation status and later relying query; distinguish artifact validity from dependent authority (DTF-001/003).

dispositions.sections: Decision Conformance; List Retention; Revoke Conformance
dispositions.local_proposition: Recorded allow grant previously valid and cached.
dispositions.relying_proposition: Cached grant record is currently valid after authoritative deletion.
dispositions.precondition_analysis: Requires previously valid grant record, effective VTA withdrawal and later current-validity reliance; grant record is the artifact under evaluation, not the permanently verifiable decision document.
dispositions.trigger: The relying system evaluates current validity using artifact evidence that does not incorporate the effective revocation state.
falsification: The system returns PASS for current validity after an authoritative revocation is known to be effective.
The system cannot establish current revocation state but converts that uncertainty into PASS.
dispositions.authority: VTA owns authoritative grant and approver resolution; bridge enforces delivery; context admin sets binding; approver decides within authority.
dispositions.expected_safe_outcome: Do not accept cached grant as current after effective withdrawal; default-deny and reconcile against VTA as required.
dispositions.potential_impact: Operator and participants; unauthorized content delivery.
dispositions.comparison: no-added-value for core stale grant mechanism already in #135; distinguish grant validity from signature validity.

dispositions.sections: Manifest item 5; Submit Which criterion governs
dispositions.local_proposition: Prior criterion was published and may remain applicable during requirementsGrace.
dispositions.relying_proposition: Prior manifest criterion is current after successor takes effect.
dispositions.precondition_analysis: Requires actual prior and successor criterion, effective supersession before current-state query, no applicable grace or compatibility. A digest referring to an older criterion within grace is a legitimate control.
dispositions.trigger: The relying system selects or accepts the superseded artifact as current without evaluating the supersession relationship or an applicable compatibility rule.
falsification: The system returns PASS for current status solely from a superseded artifact when no applicable compatibility rule permits that reliance.
The system ignores known supersession evidence when selecting the current authoritative artifact.
dispositions.authority: VTC owns admission decision; applicable governance framework may constrain policy; live authority cannot be conferred by policy alone.
dispositions.expected_safe_outcome: Apply governing digest/grace rule; distinguish current publication from permitted prior-version reliance; refuse or defer if rule cannot be established.
dispositions.comparison: no-added-value for version-selection mechanism already explicit in submit; ceremony makes control visible.

dispositions.local_proposition: Departure can change membership status and revoke VMC.
dispositions.relying_proposition: An earlier authoritative artifact is still current despite an identified successor.
dispositions.precondition_analysis: Selected removal flow establishes withdrawal, not necessarily a successor artifact or authoritative superseding state distinct from revocation; no exact replacement relationship shown. Re-admission or rotation would require additional evidence.
dispositions.trigger: The relying system selects or accepts the superseded artifact as current without evaluating the supersession relationship or an applicable compatibility rule.
falsification: The system returns PASS for current status solely from a superseded artifact when no applicable compatibility rule permits that reliance.
The system ignores known supersession evidence when selecting the current authoritative artifact.
dispositions.authority: VTC owns lifecycle decision; member initiates own departure; administrator requires applicable community authority and policy controls.
dispositions.expected_safe_outcome: Evaluate actual revocation under DTF-004; if a successor is established, check provenance, effective time and compatibility before accepting predecessor as current.
dispositions.potential_impact: Member/service; reliance on obsolete membership evidence.
dispositions.comparison: no-added-value within selected removal path; do not double count revocation as supersession.

dispositions.sections: Decision Conformance; List change stream and scoped reads
dispositions.local_proposition: A prior grant decision can be superseded by a newer decision for the same subject.
dispositions.relying_proposition: Old allow remains current after newer authoritative deny or narrower replacement.
dispositions.precondition_analysis: Requires prior current grant, actual authoritative successor for exact subject, effective replacement before current-state query and no compatibility rule. Change-stream token alone does not establish replacement.
dispositions.trigger: The relying system selects or accepts the superseded artifact as current without evaluating the supersession relationship or an applicable compatibility rule.
falsification: The system returns PASS for current status solely from a superseded artifact when no applicable compatibility rule permits that reliance.
The system ignores known supersession evidence when selecting the current authoritative artifact.
dispositions.authority: VTA owns authoritative grant and approver resolution; bridge enforces delivery; context admin sets binding; approver decides within authority.
dispositions.expected_safe_outcome: Reconcile current grant and scope with VTA; do not treat old grant or sync token as current authorization.
dispositions.comparison: limited: prior consent cache analysis already captures stale reliance; distinguish replacement from deletion.

dispositions.sections: Submit Which criterion governs, Deciding and Retention; VTI-CMP-040–042
dispositions.local_proposition: Admission may have satisfied then-applicable criterion and credential evidence.
dispositions.relying_proposition: Admission was invalid then because criterion or credential is withdrawn now.
dispositions.precondition_analysis: Requires established historical validity at t1, later withdrawal/supersession t2 and an explicitly historical query; no presumption of historical validity from mere recorded approval.
dispositions.trigger: The relying system answers a historical-validity question using only the artifact's current withdrawn, revoked, or superseded state.
falsification: The system concludes that the artifact was invalid at the historical time solely because it is withdrawn, revoked, or superseded now.
The system collapses current-state evidence and historical-state evidence into a single undifferentiated validity result.
dispositions.authority: VTC owns admission decision; applicable governance framework may constrain policy; live authority cannot be conferred by policy alone.
dispositions.expected_safe_outcome: Reconstruct then-applicable criterion and status at t1, distinguish later event; if evidence missing report historical indeterminate rather than retroactive invalidity.
dispositions.potential_impact: Member/community; wrongful historical disqualification or loss of contestability.
dispositions.comparison: added-value: links historical admission decision inputs and later lifecycle events across stages.

dispositions.sections: Removal audit and disposition; VTI-MEM-002,030–034; VTI-CMP-040–042
dispositions.local_proposition: Earlier membership may have been valid before effective separation.
dispositions.relying_proposition: Current departure proves earlier membership was never valid.
dispositions.precondition_analysis: Requires established validity at historical time, later status change and historical question. Lawful purge may make reconstruction unavailable; cannot infer invalidity or require unlimited retention.
dispositions.trigger: The relying system answers a historical-validity question using only the artifact's current withdrawn, revoked, or superseded state.
falsification: The system concludes that the artifact was invalid at the historical time solely because it is withdrawn, revoked, or superseded now.
The system collapses current-state evidence and historical-state evidence into a single undifferentiated validity result.
dispositions.authority: VTC owns lifecycle decision; member initiates own departure; administrator requires applicable community authority and policy controls.
dispositions.expected_safe_outcome: Answer historical validity using competent historical evidence and rules; report unavailable/indeterminate when erased; do not treat current departure as retroactive proof.
dispositions.potential_impact: Former member/community; denial of historical entitlements or excessive retention.
dispositions.comparison: added-value: admission-to-separation trace exposes historical/current distinction and retention trade-off.

dispositions.sections: Decision evidence and grantedAt/expiresAt; Revoke audit; VTI-CMP-040–042
dispositions.local_proposition: Grant may have validly authorized an earlier delivery.
dispositions.relying_proposition: Later revocation proves earlier delivery lacked consent.
dispositions.precondition_analysis: Requires exact historical grant and authorized delivery context at t1, later withdrawal t2 and historical query; current absence alone cannot establish original validity either.
dispositions.trigger: The relying system answers a historical-validity question using only the artifact's current withdrawn, revoked, or superseded state.
falsification: The system concludes that the artifact was invalid at the historical time solely because it is withdrawn, revoked, or superseded now.
The system collapses current-state evidence and historical-state evidence into a single undifferentiated validity result.
dispositions.authority: VTA owns authoritative grant and approver resolution; bridge enforces delivery; context admin sets binding; approver decides within authority.
dispositions.expected_safe_outcome: Use retained admissible grant provenance and historical effect/scope; qualify unavailable evidence rather than infer retroactive invalidity.
dispositions.potential_impact: Operator/participants; erroneous disputes or excessive audit retention.
dispositions.comparison: added-value conditional on historical review of grant-to-delivery relation; no proof of actual retained history.

dispositions.sections: Submit Deciding; Decide Conformance; Admit referral/execution; VTI-APV-017
dispositions.local_proposition: A review or referred direct admission was blocked pending competent decision.
dispositions.relying_proposition: Condition remains unresolved solely because earlier state was pending despite valid current approval.
dispositions.precondition_analysis: Requires actual blocking condition, admissible resolution under applicable rule and evidence still current. Approval resolves only its own condition; other criteria and live capability still apply. Supplement path not assumed.
dispositions.trigger: The relying system continues to block, defer, or report the condition as unresolved because it preserves the earlier unresolved state without reassessing current admissible evidence.
falsification: The system continues to block solely because the condition was once unresolved even though current admissible resolution evidence is sufficient.
A valid resolution event is ignored without evidence that it became stale, revoked, conflicting, superseded, or otherwise invalid.
The system cannot distinguish legitimate continued blocking from failure to re-evaluate the resolved condition.
dispositions.authority: VTC owns admission decision; applicable governance framework may constrain policy; live authority cannot be conferred by policy alone.
dispositions.expected_safe_outcome: Re-evaluate resolved condition and remaining gates; proceed only when all applicable requirements hold; record reason for legitimate continued blocking.
dispositions.potential_impact: Applicant/community; unjustified denial or premature admission.
dispositions.comparison: added-value: distinguishes legitimate recovery from persistent stale workflow state.

dispositions.local_proposition: Departure completion may initially be unestablished while authoritative effects are pending.
dispositions.relying_proposition: Departure remains reported unresolved after current admissible community evidence establishes the particular required effect.
dispositions.precondition_analysis: Requires earlier consequential deferral, competent resolution of the same condition and current evidence. Receipt alone does not resolve downstream access, publication or erasure conditions outside its claim.
dispositions.trigger: The relying system continues to block, defer, or report the condition as unresolved because it preserves the earlier unresolved state without reassessing current admissible evidence.
falsification: The system continues to block solely because the condition was once unresolved even though current admissible resolution evidence is sufficient.
A valid resolution event is ignored without evidence that it became stale, revoked, conflicting, superseded, or otherwise invalid.
The system cannot distinguish legitimate continued blocking from failure to re-evaluate the resolved condition.
dispositions.authority: VTC owns lifecycle decision; member initiates own departure; administrator requires applicable community authority and policy controls.
dispositions.expected_safe_outcome: Update only the resolved condition; reassess outstanding dependent effects; do not repeat removal or withhold a supported departure determination solely because it was pending.
dispositions.potential_impact: Departing member/service; unjustified continued membership or service delay.
dispositions.comparison: added-value: distinguish individual effect resolution from whole-ceremony completion.

dispositions.sections: Request Conformance; Decision Conformance; List Retention
dispositions.local_proposition: Unknown subject causes held delivery pending valid allow.
dispositions.relying_proposition: Delivery remains blocked solely because pending state was not reassessed after a current valid allow.
dispositions.precondition_analysis: Requires earlier material block, exact authorized current allow satisfying release condition and no later deny/revoke/expiry or other independent blocking rule. Not every held message must be released regardless of policy or retention.
dispositions.trigger: The relying system continues to block, defer, or report the condition as unresolved because it preserves the earlier unresolved state without reassessing current admissible evidence.
falsification: The system continues to block solely because the condition was once unresolved even though current admissible resolution evidence is sufficient.
A valid resolution event is ignored without evidence that it became stale, revoked, conflicting, superseded, or otherwise invalid.
The system cannot distinguish legitimate continued blocking from failure to re-evaluate the resolved condition.
dispositions.authority: VTA owns authoritative grant and approver resolution; bridge enforces delivery; context admin sets binding; approver decides within authority.
dispositions.expected_safe_outcome: Reassess exact grant and remaining delivery policy; do not preserve obsolete pending classification; release only where otherwise permitted.
dispositions.potential_impact: Operator/participants; unjustified denial or delayed communication.
dispositions.comparison: limited: request/decision already specifies release; ceremony records recovery as distinct from fail-open prevention.

limitations: Conditional documentary hypotheses, not observed failures.

DTF-006 and DTF-031 require preserving the canonical negative/falsification semantics; the disposition for a prohibited false conclusion is not a universal DENY of the underlying transaction or historical claim.
Do not equate artifact revocation, supersession, authority withdrawal or historical invalidity.
Per-precondition adversarial review and matrix validation remain pending.
